veg.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Divide the plant-based mince into four loose balls and slice the onion very thin.
Heat a griddle until very hot. Put the mince balls on it, top with onion and press firmly into thin patties. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes until well browned, flip and cook a further 2 minutes. Lay the cheese on top to melt.
Toast the buns and fill with the patties, pickles and mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; fry everything just before serving

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the olive oil over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and crisp at the edges. Stir through the smoked paprika and soy sauce and lift out onto a plate.
Melt a little of the butter in the same pan and fry the eggs, spooning the butter over the yolks until the whites are set.
Meanwhile toast the white bread and spread with the rest of the butter.
Plate the eggs with the smoky mushrooms and buttered toast.

veg.n: Prom night eggplant parmesan and fries
veg.make_ahead: Crumb up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the eggplants lengthways into 8 thick slices and crumb in flour, egg then panko. Cut the potatoes into chips, soak in cold water, then dry well.
Fry the chips in the vegetable oil at a low heat until soft, drain, then fry again at a high heat until golden.
Shallow fry the eggplant in some of the oil until golden outside and soft all the way through.
Top each slice with napoli sauce, smoked tofu and mozzarella and grill until bubbling. Serve with the chips and salad leaves.

veg.make_ahead: Rub and wrap the cauliflower up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled; make the coleslaw up to 4 hours ahead; bake, then finish on the coals on the night

steps.text: Cut each cauliflower into 4 thick wedges through the stem. Brush with the olive oil and rub with the paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, cayenne and salt.
Wrap the wedges in foil in two parcels.
Bake at 180C for 40 minutes until a knife slides into the stem easily.
Shred the cabbage and carrot and toss with mayonnaise for a crunchy coleslaw.
Unwrap the cauliflower, brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky and charred.

veg.n: Smoky mushroom, egg and cheese on a roll
veg.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the olive oil over high heat until browned and crisp at the edges, then stir through the smoked paprika.
Fry the eggs in the same pan, breaking the yolks, and lay a slice of cheese on each to melt.
Split, butter and toast the rolls. Fill with the mushrooms and egg, season with salt and pepper and add tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into thick slabs and patted dry

steps.text: Cook the rice and keep warm.
Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar until syrupy.
Toss the tofu in the cornflour and fry in the vegetable oil until crisp and golden on both sides, then pour in the sauce and turn until glazed.
Slice the tofu over the rice and top with pickled ginger and spring onion.

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into thick slabs and patted dry

steps.text: Cook the rice and keep warm.
Simmer the soy, apple juice, water, rice vinegar and sugar until syrupy.
Toss the tofu in the cornflour and fry in the vegetable oil until crisp and golden on both sides, then pour in the sauce and turn until glazed.
Slice the tofu over the rice and top with pickled ginger and spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Dice the onion and roll the plant-based mince into balls up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; smash and cook on the night

steps.text: Roll the plant-based mince into eight balls and dice the onion.
Smash each flat on a smoking griddle, season with salt and cook until well browned underneath.
Flip, top with cheese and cook a minute more. Toast the buns.
Stack two per bun with onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Stud and rub the cauliflowers up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; make the mint sauce up to 2 days ahead. Roast on the night

steps.text: Poke small cuts all over the cauliflowers and stud with the garlic and rosemary. Rub with the olive oil and salt, and halve the potatoes.
Roast at 200C with the potatoes alongside, turning the potatoes once, until the cauliflowers are deep golden and a knife slides into the centre.
Mix the mint with sugar, vinegar and boiling water for mint sauce.
Cut the cauliflowers into wedges and serve with the potatoes and mint sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the olive oil until browned, then add the diced onion and carrots and cook until soft.
Stir in the lentils, tomato paste, soy sauce and stock and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes, mash with most of the butter and the milk.
Tip the filling into a baking dish, spread the mash over and rough up the top with a fork.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Toss the peas with the last of the butter and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Make the gravy up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; brown and simmer the cauliflower on the night so it stays firm

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into 4 thick steaks, keeping the loose florets. Flour them and brown in the oil in batches.
Make a dark roux in the pan with the butter and the rest of the flour.
Add the sliced onions and stock and stir until smooth.
Return the cauliflower and simmer in the gravy until tender.
Cook the rice and braise the kale with garlic.
Serve the cauliflower and gravy over the rice with the kale.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into small florets and mix with the yoghurt, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon, lemon juice and olive oil.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Spread on a lined tray and roast at 230C, turning once, until tender and charred at the edges.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with the cauliflower, garlic sauce, pickled turnips, tomato and parsley.

veg.make_ahead: Wipe and trim the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead; sear them and make the pan sauce on the night

steps.text: Wipe the mushrooms, trim the stems and season with the salt flakes.
Sear hard in the olive oil in a hot pan, pressing down, until browned on both sides.
Baste with part of the butter and thyme for a minute, then lift the mushrooms out.
Add the wine and stock to the pan and reduce by half, then whisk in the rest of the butter.
Slice the mushrooms and pour over the sauce.

veg_af.make_ahead: Trim the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; the vinegar and stock sauce is best made in the pan on the night

steps.text: Wipe the mushrooms, trim the stems and season with the salt flakes.
Sear hard in the olive oil in a hot pan, pressing down, until browned on both sides.
Baste with part of the butter and thyme for a minute, then lift the mushrooms out.
Add the stock and red wine vinegar to the pan and reduce by half, then whisk in the rest of the butter.
Slice the mushrooms and pour over the sauce.

veg.n: Billy Ray's club dinner, roast celeriac
veg.make_ahead: Rub the celeriac with oil, salt and thyme up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; roast, crust and carve on the night

steps.text: Peel the celeriac, rub with 1 tbsp of the oil, the salt and thyme, and sit in a roasting tin.
Roast the celeriac at 180C for 50 minutes, basting with the tin juices.
Toss the potatoes in the rest of the oil and roast on another shelf with the celeriac for 45 minutes more.
Brush the celeriac with the butter, turn the oven to 230C and roast 10 minutes for a crust.
Pour the tin juices into a small pan with the stock and soy sauce and simmer for jus.
Carve the celeriac into thick slices and serve with horseradish cream, potatoes and jus.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the haloumi up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; make the chapati and grill on the night

steps.text: Mix the lemon juice, garlic, chilli flakes, paprika and some of the oil and coat the haloumi.
Leave the haloumi to marinate while you make the chapati.
Mix the flour, salt, remaining oil and warm water into a dough, knead, then rest.
Roll the dough into rounds and dry-fry each side in a hot pan.
Grill the haloumi, turning once, until golden and charred.
Toss the tomatoes, onion, coriander and lime juice for the kachumbari and serve with the haloumi and chapati.

veg.make_ahead: Mash the potatoes and braise the cabbage up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and reheat; sear the sausages and roast with the apples on the night

steps.text: Sear the vegetarian sausages in the oil in an ovenproof pan until golden.
Add the apples and onions to the pan and roast at 200C.
Boil the potatoes and mash with most of the butter.
Braise the cabbage in the rest of the butter and the water until soft.
Serve it all on big plates.

veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead, fry to serve

steps.text: Fry the onion, mushrooms and sweet potato in 2 tbsp of the oil with the chopped chipotles and cumin. Add the water, cover and simmer until soft.
Stir in the black beans and crush roughly with a fork.
Fill the tortillas with the filling and cheddar and fold tight.
Fry in the rest of the oil at 180C until crisp.
Serve with sour cream, guacamole and salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Brown the mushrooms and assemble the dish up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; bake on the night

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil, gill side down first, in a baking dish on the stove
Add the butter beans, garlic, thyme and wine
Cover and bake at 180C
Squeeze the soft garlic onto slices of crusty Italian loaf and eat with the mushrooms and beans

veg_af.make_ahead: Brown the mushrooms and assemble the dish up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; bake on the night

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil, gill side down first, in a baking dish on the stove
Add the butter beans, garlic, thyme, stock and vinegar
Cover and bake at 180C
Squeeze the soft garlic onto slices of crusty Italian loaf and eat with the mushrooms and beans

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

ingredients.item: pumpkin, peeled and cut into chunks

steps.text: Brown the pumpkin in the oil.
Soften the onion with the ginger and saffron. Add the water, preserved lemon, olives, chickpeas and pumpkin.
Cover and simmer until the pumpkin is tender.
Steep the couscous in the boiling water, fluff with a fork and serve under the tagine.

veg.n: Uncle Benny's five spice roast mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Toss the mushrooms with the oil, five spice and salt up to 4 hours ahead, covered; roast, glaze and serve on the night

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the oil, five spice and salt and spread on a lined tray.
Roast at 220C, turning once, until crisp and browned.
Brush with the honey and soy and roast for the last stretch until sticky.
Slice the cucumber and spring onions and warm the pancakes. Serve with the mushrooms and hoisin.

veg.make_ahead: Dice the onion and grate the cheese up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the risotto just before serving as it does not hold

steps.text: Soften the diced onion in some of the butter.
Add the rice and toast, then add the wine.
Add the hot stock ladle by ladle, with the saffron steeped in, stirring.
Finish with the rest of the butter and the parmesan.

veg_af.make_ahead: Chop the onion and grate the cheese up to 1 day ahead; keep the stock hot and cook and serve the risotto straight away

steps.text: Soften the diced onion in some of the butter.
Add the rice and toast, then add the vinegar and a ladle of the stock.
Add the hot stock ladle by ladle, with the saffron steeped in, stirring.
Finish with the rest of the butter and the parmesan.

veg.make_ahead: Mushroom sauce up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Shred the mushrooms lengthways with a fork and fry in batches in half the olive oil until browned.
Fry the onion, capsicums and garlic in the rest of the olive oil until soft.
Add the cumin, oregano, bay leaves, tomatoes, stock, olives and mushrooms and simmer until thick.
Cook the rice and warm the black beans, and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the 40g butter.
Cook the peas and toss with their butter.
Fry the mushrooms in the olive oil over high heat until browned.
Add the gravy butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick and glossy.
Toast the bread, lay on plates, pile on the mushrooms and pour over the gravy. Serve with the mash and peas.

veg.make_ahead: Blitz the paste and marinate the tofu up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the rice and grill the tofu on the night

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into thick slabs

steps.text: Blitz the allspice, thyme, chilli, lime juice, spring onion, soy sauce and oil into a paste.
Marinate the tofu in the paste.
Cook the rice with the drained kidney beans.
Grill the tofu until charred on both sides.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours, sear fresh

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms thick and marinate in soy, grated pear, crushed garlic and sesame oil for 30 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Toss sliced cucumbers with salt, chilli and vinegar as a quick kimchi.
Sear the mushrooms hot in the vegetable oil in batches until caramelised.
Serve with the rice and cucumbers.

veg.n: Sonny's Sunday rigatoni with mushroom meatballs
veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead, better the next day

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the olive oil until dry, then cool.
Mix the mushrooms with the ricotta, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, salt and pepper and shape into 12 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs and eggplant in the rest of the olive oil in a heavy pot, turning gently, then set aside.
Soften the onion, add the garlic, then the tomatoes, water and basil and simmer until rich.
Return the meatballs and eggplant and simmer gently until heated through.
Boil the rigatoni, drain and toss with the sauce. Serve the meatballs on a platter.

veg.n: Grilled cauliflower steak with chimichurri and corn
veg.make_ahead: Chimichurri up to 2 days ahead and potato salad up to 1 day ahead, both chilled; grill the cauliflower and corn on the night

steps.text: Blitz the parsley, oregano, garlic, chilli, vinegar and 125 ml of the olive oil for the chimichurri.
Boil the potatoes until tender and drain.
Dress the potatoes with mayonnaise and sliced spring onion.
Cut each cauliflower into 2 thick steaks through the stem, brush with the oil for brushing, season with salt and grill with the corn over hot coals until charred and tender.
Serve the cauliflower steaks with chimichurri, corn and potato salad.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to a day ahead

ingredients.item: heads cauliflower, cut into thick wedges

steps.text: Blitz the chillies, allspice, thyme, spring onions, garlic, lime juice, oil and salt into a paste and coat the cauliflower.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Grill slowly over coals, turning, until charred and tender.
Cook the rice with the drained kidney beans and coconut milk.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, shred and reheat covered

ingredients.item: tinned young jackfruit in brine, drained (2 tins)

steps.text: Trim the hard cores off the jackfruit and rub with the smoked salt and vegetable oil.
Wrap tightly in banana leaves, then foil.
Cook at 180C until very soft.
While it cooks, cook the jasmine rice and shred the cabbage with lime juice and sesame oil.
Shred the jackfruit with two forks and serve over rice with the cabbage salad.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms and capsicum and grate the mozzarella up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; stretch the dough and bake on the night

steps.text: Stretch the dough into 2 thin bases.
Spread with sauce, then add mozzarella, mushrooms, capsicum, chilli flakes and oregano.
Bake on a hot steel at maximum heat.
Cut into squares and leave in the box on the bench.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce and meatballs up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, grated, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then cool.
Mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, parmesan, parsley, egg and breadcrumbs, then roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in the rest of the oil in batches.
Add the tomatoes and basil and simmer gently until the sauce is thick.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente and pile on one big plate with the sauce. Leave the last meatball for your date.

veg.make_ahead: Make the chimichurri up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and slice the haloumi up to 1 day ahead; grill on the night

steps.text: Blitz the parsley, garlic, oregano, chilli, vinegar and oil into chimichurri.
Grill the corn, turning.
Grill the vegetarian sausages, turning, until browned.
Grill the haloumi over high heat until charred on both sides.
Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Spoon the chimichurri over the haloumi and serve with the corn, vegetarian sausages and slaw.

veg.make_ahead: Make the burger sauce up to 2 days ahead and roll the patties up to 1 day ahead, both chilled; bake the fries and smash the patties on the night

steps.text: Bake the frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with salt and paprika.
Roll the plant-based mince into 8 balls.
Smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute.
Mix the mayonnaise, the tomato sauce, the mustard and chopped pickles.
Toast the buns, spread with sauce and stack the patties with diced onion and pickles.

veg.n: Sgt Hulka's mess hall lentil loaf
veg.make_ahead: Bake the loaf until firm up to 1 day ahead, then slice and reheat covered; make the mash and gravy on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and grated onion in the oil until dry.
Mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, eggs, breadcrumbs, cheddar, 2 tsp of the soy sauce and the salt. Press into a lined loaf tin.
Spread with the tomato sauce mixed with the sugar and bake at 180C until firm.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with some of the butter and the milk.
Fry the sliced onions in the rest of the butter, stir in the flour, then the stock and the rest of the soy sauce, and simmer to a gravy.
Cook the peas and serve everything together.

veg.make_ahead: Loaf up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil until dry.
Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the mashed lentils, mushrooms, eggs, cheddar and soy sauce.
Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with tomato sauce and bake at 180C until firm.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter. Cook the peas.
Rest the loaf, slice and serve with mash and peas.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the haloumi, tomatoes and mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook everything just before serving

steps.text: Bake the hash browns at 220C until crisp.
Fry the vegetarian sausages in the oil over medium heat.
Fry the haloumi in the same pan until golden on both sides.
Fry the tomatoes cut-side down. Fry the mushrooms in some of the butter with the garlic.
Fry the eggs in a little more of the butter.
Toast the bread and butter it well. Load up plates and serve with tomato sauce.

veg.n: Pancakes, smoky mushrooms and fried eggs
veg.make_ahead: Whisk the pancake batter up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the pancakes, mushrooms and eggs fresh

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, two eggs and buttermilk into a batter.
Cook the pancakes in butter and keep warm.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until browned, then toss with the smoked paprika and soy sauce.
Fry the four remaining eggs.
Pile it all on a big plate and pour over maple syrup.

veg.make_ahead: Cube and pat dry the tofu and slice the capsicum up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; stir-fry on the night

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cubed and patted dry

steps.text: Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the tofu in the oil in a hot wok until golden.
Add the capsicum and cook briefly.
Toss through the noodles with sweet chilli and soy sauce until sticky and pack into takeaway boxes.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Roll the plant-based mince into 8 balls. Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce.
Smash each flat on a smoking griddle, season with salt and cook, then flip and add cheese.
Stack 2 per toasted bun with pickles, diced onion and sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into fries and dry well
Mash the black beans with the egg, breadcrumbs, paprika, cumin and half the salt, and shape into 4 patties
Fry the fries in the oil once at a lower heat, then again at a higher heat until golden. Salt well
Fry the patties in 2 tbsp of the oil until crisp on both sides and melt the cheddar on top
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles

veg.make_ahead: Press the tofu and cut into slabs up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; flour and sear on the night

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into 8 slabs and patted dry

steps.text: Press the tofu slabs between paper towel, then flour.
Boil the pasta until tender and drain.
Sear the tofu in oil until golden on both sides.
Add the wine, lemon juice and capers and reduce.
Whisk in the butter. Toss the pasta through and serve the tofu on top.

veg_af.make_ahead: Press and slab the tofu up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; make the stock and vinegar pan sauce on the night

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into 8 slabs and patted dry

steps.text: Press the tofu slabs between paper towel, then flour.
Boil the pasta until tender and drain.
Sear the tofu in oil until golden on both sides.
Add the stock, vinegar, lemon juice and capers and reduce.
Whisk in the butter. Toss the pasta through and serve the tofu on top.

veg.n: Klaus's juniper mushroom stew with mash
veg.make_ahead: Stew better the next day

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Slice the onions and chop the carrots, then cook with the mushrooms.
Stir in the flour, juniper, thyme, jam, soy sauce, lentils and stock.
Cover and simmer until thick and rich.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter and milk.
Serve the stew over the mash.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the congee up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled and loosen with hot water when reheating; fry the shiitake and eggs fresh

steps.text: Simmer the rice in the stock with the ginger for 90 minutes, stirring often, until silky.
Fry the shiitake in the oil until crisp at the edges, then fry the eggs in the same pan.
Top each bowl with an egg and a mushroom smile, spring onion and soy.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days, cook fresh

steps.text: Toss the potatoes, cut into fries, in oil and bake at 220C, turning once, until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chopped pickles for the special sauce. Roll the plant-based mince into 4 balls.
Smash the balls flat on a very hot pan. Season, flip after 2 minutes and add the cheese.
Build on toasted buns with onion, pickle slices and sauce. Serve with the fries.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

ingredients.item: large cauliflower, cut into big florets

steps.text: Rub the cauliflower with harissa, olive oil, lemon juice and salt.
Spread the chickpeas and onions in a tray and sit the cauliflower on top.
Roast at 200C for 35 minutes until charred and tender.
Mix the cucumber into the yoghurt. Warm the flatbreads and serve everything together.

veg.n: Jenny Lind opening night nut roast
veg.make_ahead: Shape the nut roast up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus 1 tbsp for the gravy

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry.
Mix with the nuts, breadcrumbs, cheddar, 2 of the eggs, thyme, salt and pepper. Press into a lined loaf tin and bake at 200C until firm and browned.
Roast the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil on another shelf.
Whisk the other 3 eggs, the flour and milk and bake in tins oiled with the last of the oil at 220C.
Melt the butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, add the red wine and reduce, then whisk in the stock and simmer for gravy.
Rest the nut roast, slice and serve with the potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravy.

veg_af.n: Jenny Lind opening night nut roast (alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Shape the nut roast up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus 1 tbsp for the gravy

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry.
Mix with the nuts, breadcrumbs, cheddar, 2 of the eggs, thyme, salt and pepper. Press into a lined loaf tin and bake at 200C until firm and browned.
Roast the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil on another shelf.
Whisk the other 3 eggs, the flour and milk and bake in tins oiled with the last of the oil at 220C.
Melt the butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in the stock and balsamic vinegar and simmer for gravy.
Rest the nut roast, slice and serve with the potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Jus up to 2 days ahead; roast the mushrooms to serve

ingredients.item: dried oregano, plus 1 tsp for the jus
black pepper, plus more for the jus

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the oil, salt, pepper and oregano and roast at 220C until browned and tender.
Simmer the stock with the soy sauce, garlic, oregano and plenty of pepper.
Warm the mushrooms in the jus, pile into the rolls, dip the whole sandwich and top with giardiniera.

veg.n: Crossroads tavern mushroom and root veg stew
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onion, carrots and parsnips and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then the stock, barley, soy sauce, thyme and bay leaf.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour until the barley is tender and the sauce is rich.
Serve in bowls with crusty bread and butter.

veg.n: Lime grilled haloumi with mango salsa
veg.make_ahead: Make the mango salsa up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; rub the haloumi and grill it to serve

steps.text: Rub the haloumi with lime juice and crushed garlic.
Dice the mango, chilli and red onion and mix with lime juice for salsa.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk with a pinch of salt and a splash of water.
Grill the haloumi until golden and charred on both sides.
Serve the haloumi on the rice with the salsa.

veg.n: Flo's café mushroom and haloumi burgers
veg.make_ahead: Slice the onions and haloumi up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry the chips and grill the mushrooms on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into crinkle chips.
Fry the chips twice in the oil until crisp.
Trim the mushroom stems, brush with 1 tbsp of the oil and season with salt.
Grill the mushrooms until tender, melting cheddar on top at the end.
Fry the haloumi and onion in a little oil until golden.
Toast the buns.
Stack it all in the buns and serve with the chips.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Mix lime juice, a little orange juice, crushed garlic, cumin, oil and salt, then add the mushrooms.
Marinate the mushrooms for 30 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and warm the beans in a small pot.
Sear the mushrooms over very high heat for 4 minutes a side, char the spring onions in the same pan.
Slice the mushrooms thick.
Serve with the rice, beans and spring onions.

veg.n: Mumble's smoked tofu and egg pie
veg.make_ahead: Assemble the pie up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; bake on the night

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and quarter.
Soften the leeks in some of the butter.
Stir in the flour, then the milk, and simmer to a sauce. Add the smoked tofu, chopped parsley and eggs and pour into a dish.
Top with the potatoes boiled and mashed with the rest of the butter and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake fresh with the tots on top

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince with the onion in the oil. Add the mushrooms and cook until their liquid has gone.
Stir in the corn, beans and cream and simmer briefly. Spread in a baking dish.
Cover with neat rows of potato gems and bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead, better the next day

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in oil.
Layer in a heavy pot with the onions, carrots, potatoes and barley.
Pour over the stout and stock, cover and braise at 160C for 1 and a half hours until tender.
Finish with parsley.

veg_af.n: Leo's Danny Boy Irish stew (vegetarian, alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead, better the next day

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in oil.
Layer in a heavy pot with the onions, carrots, potatoes and barley.
Pour over the stock and malt vinegar, cover and braise at 160C for 1 and a half hours until tender.
Finish with parsley.

veg.make_ahead: Chimichurri up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut each cauliflower into 2 thick steaks and rub with the olive oil, salt, pepper and smoked paprika.
Chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the vinegar, extra virgin olive oil and chilli flakes.
Grill over high heat, turning once, until charred and tender.
Spoon the chimichurri over the cauliflower steaks.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Soften the leeks in the butter.
Add the cannellini beans, potatoes, thyme, stock and salt.
Simmer until the potatoes break down.
Stir in the cream and serve in big bowls with torn bread.

veg.n: Jean-Claude's Bondi battered haloumi and chips
veg.make_ahead: Cut the haloumi into fingers and mix the tartare up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; batter and fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and fry in the oil at 150C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes.
Whisk the flour with the cold lager into a batter, dip the haloumi fingers and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise with chopped pickles for tartare and serve with lemon.

veg_af.n: Jean-Claude's Bondi battered haloumi and chips (alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Cut the haloumi into fingers and mix the tartare up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; whisk the batter and fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and fry in the oil at 150C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes.
Whisk the flour with the cold soda water into a batter, dip the haloumi fingers and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise with chopped pickles for tartare and serve with lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Do the first fry of the chips up to 3 hours ahead; sear the mushrooms and finish the bearnaise on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips.
Fry the chips once in the vegetable oil at a lower heat and drain.
Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon until a couple of tablespoons remain.
Whisk the reduction with the yolks over low heat and drizzle in the warm clarified butter.
Sear the mushrooms in the olive oil, then baste with butter, thyme and garlic until tender.
Fry the chips again until crisp.
Serve the mushrooms with the sauce and chips.

veg.n: Mushroom and white bean pot pie
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then add the diced onion, carrots, celery and thyme.
Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream, and simmer until thick.
Add the peas and cannellini beans and tip into a pie dish.
Cover with puff pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

veg.make_ahead: Crema and salsa up to 4 hours ahead

ingredients.item: medium cauliflower, cut into small florets

steps.text: Coat the cauliflower in the flour mixed with paprika and cumin, then egg, then panko.
Arrange on a lined tray, drizzle with oil and bake at 220C, turning halfway, until golden and tender.
Mix the sour cream with the juice of one lime for the crema, and toss the tomato and onion with the juice of the other lime.
Warm the tortillas as the packet says and fill with cauliflower, cabbage, salsa and crema. Keep any chilli on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep the soup chilled and the toppings fresh

ingredients.item: thickened cream, plus a little extra to swirl
salt and white pepper, to taste

steps.text: Slice the leeks, keeping a few green tops aside, and dice the potatoes.
Soften the leeks and potatoes in most of the butter without browning.
Add the stock and simmer until the potato is very soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season with salt and white pepper.
Fry thin strips of the green leek tops in the hot vegetable oil until crisp, and blitz the chives with the olive oil.
Serve the soup with a swirl of cream, the chive oil, crispy leeks and crusty bread spread with the last of the butter.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the tofu and simmer the shiitake up to 1 day ahead, chilled; soft-boil the eggs, heat the stock and cook the noodles on the night

steps.text: Fry the tofu in the oil until golden on both sides.
Add the shiitake, soy sauce, sugar and water and simmer, turning, until sticky.
Soft-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Heat the stock and whisk in the miso.
Cook the noodles and build each bowl differently with tofu, shiitake, eggs, corn and nori.

veg.make_ahead: Score and stud the eggplants up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and simmer the chickpeas up to 2 days ahead; roast on the night

steps.text: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh deeply and stud the cuts with garlic, rosemary and capers. Brush with the oil and season with salt.
Roast at 200C until soft and collapsing.
Meanwhile simmer the chickpeas with the tomatoes, then stir through the spinach.
Serve the eggplant on the chickpeas with the feta crumbled over.

veg.n: Honeymoon roast butternut with garlic thyme butter
veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Mix the butter with crushed garlic, thyme and salt.
Peel the pumpkin, halve lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Cut deep slices across each half without cutting through, then rub with the butter.
Cut the potatoes into chunks and set a rack over them in a roasting tin with the pumpkin on top.
Roast at 200C, turning the potatoes halfway, until the pumpkin is tender and golden.
Rest, then slice.

veg.n: Eden Prairie food court teriyaki tofu
veg.make_ahead: Glaze up to 3 days ahead

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into thick slabs

steps.text: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger until syrupy.
Steam the rice. Brush the tofu with the oil and grill, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred.
Stir-fry the broccoli quickly. Slice the tofu over the rice and spoon over the extra sauce.

veg_af.n: Eden Prairie food court teriyaki tofu (alcohol-free)

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into thick slabs

steps.text: Simmer the soy sauce, apple juice, rice vinegar, sugar and ginger until syrupy.
Steam the rice. Brush the tofu with the oil and grill, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred.
Stir-fry the broccoli quickly. Slice the tofu over the rice and spoon over the extra sauce.

veg.n: Captain Hook's mushroom and allspice stew
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms in the flour. Slice the onions, chop the carrots and cube the sweet potato.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Soften the onions and carrots.
Return the mushrooms and add the sweet potato, kidney beans, allspice, molasses, tomato paste and stock.
Cover and simmer gently until thick and the sweet potato is tender.
Season well with salt and pepper and serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Roll the plant-based mince into balls and slice the onion up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; smash and cook to serve

steps.text: Roll the plant-based mince into eight balls and slice the onion very thinly.
Heat a griddle until very hot. Put a few onion slices on each ball and smash flat, onion side down.
Flip after 90 seconds, add a slice of cheese and cook briefly.
Toast the buns.
Stack two patties per bun with pickles and mustard.

veg.n: Tuohy Thanksgiving sage butter pumpkin at the table
veg.make_ahead: Gravy and sides up to 1 day ahead, roast the pumpkin fresh

steps.text: Chop half the sage, mix with a third of the butter and rub over the pumpkin wedges.
Roast at 200C until tender and caramelised at the edges.
Fry the diced onion and celery in a little butter, then mix with the crumbled cornbread, remaining chopped sage, egg and 250ml of the stock. Bake until golden.
Peel, chop and boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Blanch the green beans and toss in butter.
Melt the last of the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the rest of the stock and the soy sauce and simmer for gravy.
Serve with cranberry sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes up to 3 hours ahead and keep them in cold water; fry, sear the mushrooms and make the bearnaise on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries.
Fry twice in the vegetable oil until crisp.
Sear the mushrooms in the olive oil until browned and tender, season with salt and pepper and keep warm.
Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon.
Whisk in the egg yolks over gentle heat.
Slowly add the melted butter, whisking.
Serve the mushrooms over the fries with the bearnaise.

veg.make_ahead: Pat dry and cube the tofu and prep the vegetables up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; stir-fry and toss with the noodles just before serving

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cubed and patted dry

steps.text: Slice the capsicum and cut the broccoli into florets.
Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the tofu in the oil in a hot wok until golden.
Add the capsicum and broccoli and cook.
Toss in the noodles with soy and honey until sticky and glossy.
